title: Celestial Wolf Eclipse
description: A stylized wolf in profile with its head lowered, overlaid with a glowing orange and pink celestial orb that merges with its form. The background features a dark purple and red sky with faint floating letter Ds and geometric shapes.
prompt: Stylized wolf in profile with head lowered, its body and head formed from earthy green and yellow tones with bold black outlines. A large glowing orange-pink celestial orb overlaps the wolf's head and back creating an eclipse effect. Dark purple and red cloudy sky background with faint floating letter D symbols and geometric patterns, dramatic lighting, surreal symbolic composition, digital illustration style.
